topics.text: Rooms are spacious, well-maintained, and equipped with modern amenities. Many guests highlighted the cleanliness, dry environment (with dehumidifiers and mosquito nets), and absence of pests, particularly appreciating the views from windows or balconies.
Staff are consistently described as friendly, attentive, and helpful, often assisting with luggage, providing travel recommendations, and ensuring a comfortable stay despite the challenging location.

The hotel offers panoramic views of greenery from its elevated position, with opportunities to enjoy sunrise, moonlit nights, and natural sounds like bamboo rustling. The historic architecture and tranquil setting enhance the overall experience.

address: No. 435 Yinshan Street, Moganshan Scenic Area, Deqing, Zhejiang, China
